packageRules.description: Label Go updates like Dependabot did
Label GitHub Actions updates like Dependabot did
The golang.org/x modules are released together every month
Leave the Go version in go.mod alone. Moving to a new Go release is a deliberate change, together with the version in the workflows.
Group the home-assistant/builder subactions into one PR (they share a release)
Docker Hub returns no release timestamps for the golang image, so the minimum release age would keep it pending forever
Leave runner labels and action version inputs alone, Dependabot never updated those

Our own actions that follow a branch (like home-assistant/actions@master) float on purpose. Pinning them would open a digest PR in every repository for each change to them. Our own actions on a version tag are pinned like any other.
